lead.t: Renal blood flow (RBF) autoregulation – myogenic response + tubuloglomerular feedback (TGF) maintains GFR between MAP ≈ 80‑180 mmHg: When MAP falls below the autoregulatory range, afferent arteriolar dilation is insufficient → ↓RBF → ↓GFR (pre‑renal).
